# Shuvang Arjyal

> Portfolio of Shuvang Arjyal, an IT graduate (Charles Darwin University, 2025) in Darwin, NT, Australia, with full work rights, applying for the NT Government Graduate Development Program and AO3 to AO5 ICT roles, and open to entry-level IT work in private business. Available to start now.

Four years running shifts at McDonald's and Nando's, fixing kiosks, POS terminals, printers and kitchen screens mid-rush; IT and Automation Intern at DGK Business Consultancy; ACS Professional Year (ICT).
